Summary: Izol systém, s.r.o. je popredný slovenský veľkoobchodný dodávateľ tepelných, technických, stavebných, chladových, akustických, protipožiarnych a žiaruvzdorných izolácií. Firma pôsobí od roku 2001, sídli v Trenčíne, má pobočku vo Zvolene, vlastnú dopravu, skladové zásoby a skúsenosti zo stoviek projektov.

Key-facts:
- Official importer and distributor of K-FLEX synthetic rubber insulation for Slovakia.
- Supplies insulation materials for temperatures from -260 C to +1430 C.
- Supplies K-FLEX, UNIFRAX / SIBRAL, ROCKWOOL, KNAUF INSULATION, ISOVER, TUBEX, MIRELON and fire-protection systems.
- Provides wholesale supply, technical consulting, quotations, specifications, logistics and own transport.
- Important references include Jurkovicova teplaren, Zuckermandel, Klingerka, IKEA Industry Malacky, Nemocnica novej generacie, Konstruktorska Business Center and Gdanski Business Center I.

Services:
- Wholesale distribution of insulation materials.
- Technical consulting and insulation material selection.
- Fire-protection and HVAC insulation guidance.
- Project quotations from bill of quantities and technical documentation.
- Logistics and delivery from warehouses in Trencin and Zvolen.

Products:
- K-FLEX synthetic rubber insulation for cooling, heating, HVAC, air-conditioning and solar circuits.
- UNIFRAX / SIBRAL refractory insulation up to +1430 C.
- EPS, XPS, mineral wool and glass wool building insulation.
- Technical and fire-protection insulation for HVAC ducts, pipework, tanks and chimneys.
- Accessories including tapes, adhesives, cleaners, welding pins and tools.
